description: dvschema: Dataverse schema as YAML in Git (pull, validate, plan, push, drift, docs, seed, export, import, MCP server). Works with Microsoft Dataverse; not a Microsoft product.
releaseNotes:
**Snippets for form scripts.** Ready-made form-script code that knows your tables. [Watch the snippets video](https://github.com/SimonAllport/DataverseToCode-assets/blob/main/video/tour-snippets.mp4).

- **21 built-in snippets:** show or hide a field, section or tab; required and locking; default, copy and calculate values; filter a lookup; messages; block or confirm a save; read related records. Inserting one asks for what it needs from your table and forms (the column, the choice's value, the section) and writes the code with those names filled in.
- **Three ways in:** type `dv` in a form script, use **Insert Snippet…**, or browse the **Snippet Library** (search, insert, copy, or copy into the project to change it). In a type-checked script (`// @ts-check`) the inserted handler is typed like the script's own, so its form completes the table's columns.
- **Your own snippets:** one `.js` file each in the project's `snippets/` folder, committed with the project. One with the same prefix as a built-in replaces it; a mistake in a header is shown on the file.
- **Save as Snippet…:** select code you'd use again; the table's names in it become placeholders, so it works on any table.
- **A team library:** point the project at a Git repository of snippets (GitHub or Azure DevOps) with **Set Up Snippets…** or when connecting a new project, and everyone gets them, refreshed daily and kept for offline use. **Share to team library…** sends one of yours there as a branch and a pull request. Downloads run only in a trusted workspace; git's own data is kept in the extension's storage, never in your project.
- **Add from snippet… in the form designer:** on a form's On load or On save, or a column's On change, pick a snippet that fits, answer its questions, and the designer adds the function to the form's script and a handler for each event it runs on. A form with no script yet is offered the table's scripts, or a new one.
- **CLI and AI assistants:** `dvschema snippets` lists them, `dvschema validate` checks the project's own, and the MCP server has a `snippets` tool.

**A form's scripts in the designer.**

- **Load order:** set the order a form's scripts load in (**↑**/**↓**), and remove one no handler uses.
- **Where each comes from:** each script is labelled (this project, another solution, managed, missing) with what it uses from the others, and the designer warns as you go when their order can't work (the check Plan makes).
- **Scripts from elsewhere:** **+ Add library** offers the environment's scripts too (another solution's, a managed one) or a typed name. CLI: `dvschema webresources`.
- **Functions from a list:** a handler's function is picked from the chosen script's functions, read from the environment when the project has no copy (**Other function…** still lets you type one). Pulled projects' scripts list theirs too.
- **A handler's settings:** Enabled, Pass execution context and parameters, as in the portal's Configure Event, on the Add row and with **edit** on any handler. They were already pulled and pushed; now you can see and change them without editing the YAML.

**Docs.** The how-to guide pictures every part of snippets and has a **Snippet reference** appendix listing every built-in snippet (what it does, the prefix, when it runs, what it asks for, its code), generated from the snippet files. The README links the snippets video.
